profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer at Infosys
profile.summary:
Java Full Stack Engineer | Spring Boot, Python & AWS Specialist
Computer Systems Engineer with 3 years of professional experience architecting and deploying scalable full-stack solutions. Expert in building robust enterprise backends with Java (Spring Boot) and Python, developing dynamic frontends, and migrating applications to cloud environments to improve scalability and reduce operational costs.
Key Highlights:
Full Stack Mastery: Strong command of Java (Spring Boot), Python, Node.js, and modern frontend technologies for enterprise applications.
Cloud Native & DevOps: Advanced implementation of AWS (Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB), containerization (Docker), and cloud architectures.
API Architecture: Designing and securing high-performance RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.
Agile Delivery: Experienced in driving collaborative problem-solving, CI/CD automation, and seamless deployments.
📍 Based in the Greater Denver Area, CO. Let’s connect or reach out at mikeoficialag@gmail.com for Full Stack and Software Engineering opportunities.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: La Piedad de Cabadas, Michoacán, Mexico · Hybrid

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered full-stack features for JEEI, a government-backed digital platform designed to connect entrepreneurs and business incubators.

Spearheaded the system migration from Firebase to a serverless AWS environment, utilizing Python on AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB to optimize data structures and enhance scalability.

Redesigned the backend architecture on cloud-native infrastructure, significantly improving system reliability and API performance.

Developed and optimized the frontend landing page and user interfaces, ensuring seamless API integration, responsive design, and an intuitive user experience.
